```yaml
name: Docs Automation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: 'Whether to run Claude Code'
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      create_pr:
        description: 'Whether to create PR in docs-new'
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      max_turns:
        description: 'Max Claude turns (increase if hitting limit)'
        required: true
        default: 50
        type: number

jobs:
  docs-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout InstantSearch repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude }}
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          npx claude-code --max-turns ${{ inputs.max_turns }}

      - name: Checkout docs-new repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: algolia/docs-new
          token: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          path: docs-new
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Copy generated docs to docs-new
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs-new/docs
          cp -r docs/* docs-new/docs/ || true

      - name: Commit changes to docs-new
        if: ${{ inputs.create_pr }}
        run: |
          cd docs-new
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "docs: update docs for release ${{ github.sha }}"
            git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/docs-automation/${{ github.sha }}
          fi

      - name: Create draft PR in docs-new
        if: ${{ inputs.create_pr }}
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          title: "docs: update docs for release ${{ github.sha }}"
          body: |
            This PR was generated automatically by the docs-automation workflow.
            Please review the changes.
          base: main
          branch: docs-automation/${{ github.sha }}
          draft: true
          team-reviewers: frontend-experiences-web
        working-directory: docs-new
```
